name: recon-position-mapping-load
description: Loads the legacy RBA/RBC Price/Hedge mapping (dbsystemuat.pos_1211_port_trader_mapping_table, 60 rows) into opera.recon_position_classification_input, which is empty. Target database = datasource alias target (command line option TARGET_ENV). Insert only: the scope must be empty before, so a second run is refused. Preview first, then the apply flag; the verify rule runs after the apply.

steps.note: group is the business unit and the trade group (the function appends -BU to trade_id). effective_from is a placeholder, confirm it. effective_to stays empty.

source.sql: SELECT upper(trim(`group`)) AS business_unit, upper(trim(`group`)) AS trade_group, portfolio, subportfolio, trader_name, h_p FROM dbsystemuat.pos_1211_port_trader_mapping_table WHERE upper(trim(`group`)) IN ('RBA', 'RBC')
